origin.says: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 巨 (huge) as the sound: first a rooster's spur, now a distance or gap between things.

坐.def: seat; to sit; to ride, to travel by

ety.hint: Two people 从 sitting on the ground 土

origin.says: Two 人 (people) on 土 (the ground): people sitting on the ground, as was usual before chairs. One source reads the old form as 'stay' over 'ground' instead.

坐.name: sit

origin.says: ⺖ (heart, attitude) for the meaning plus 曼 (long) as the sound and a hint: an attitude that takes a long time; first lazy or arrogant, then slow.

航.def: vessel, craft; to sail, to navigate

origin.says: 舟 (boat) for the meaning plus 亢 (high) as the sound: a boat, to sail or navigate.

航.name: sail

唱.def: to sing, to chant, to call; ditty, song

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 昌 (flourishing) as the sound: to sing; the same word as 倡 (to lead).

唱.name: sing

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 员 (member) as the sound: to reduce, to damage or harm. Simplified from 損 (員 to 员).

招.def: to summon; to recruit; to levy

ety.hint: A call 召 to arms 扌; 召 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 召 (to summon) as the sound and meaning: to beckon with the hand, hence to recruit, to attract.

招.name: beckon

届.def: deadline; period; measure word for elections, meetings, and other events

origin.says: 屆: 尸 (body) for the meaning plus 凷 (a clod) as the sound: to arrive, to reach a time; hence a session or term. The sound part 凷 has turned into 由.

届.name: session

origin.says: 林 (woods) for the meaning plus 疋 (foot) as the sound: first a thorny bush or grove; borrowed for the state of Chu, for pain, and for 'clear' in 清楚.
Simplified from 碼: 石 (stone) for the meaning plus 馬 (horse, shortened to 马) as the sound. It first wrote agate and wharf; counting chips gave the sense 'number, code'.

染.def: dye; to catch; to infect; to be contagious

ety.hint: Water 氵 and wine 九 mixed in a wooden 木 bowl

origin.says: 氵 (water), 九 (hook) and 木 (tree): cloth hung from a hook on a tree and dipped into the dye water. Earlier forms more often read 氵 beside 杂 (mixed); the water moved to the top left.

染.name: dye

喝.def: to drink; to shout, to call out

origin.says: 口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 曷 (why) as the sound. It first meant 'to shout'; 'to drink' is a later spoken meaning given to this written form.

喝.name: drink

origin.says: From 貴: a top showing two hands (a form of 臾, also the sound) over 貝 (shell money): something precious, expensive. The top became 𠀐 and 貝 became 贝.
囗 (enclosure) for the meaning plus 古 (ancient) as the sound: walled in and secure, so solid, firm.

禁.def: to restrict, to prohibit, to forbid; to endure

origin.says: 示 (altar) for the meaning plus 林 (grove) as the sound: what religion forbids, a taboo; to prohibit.

禁.name: forbid

ety.hint: A man 大 wrapped in a long 镸 cloth

origin.says: 大 (big) over 镸 (long): something big and long enough to wrap around a thing, a cover or case; also a set. Originally a word for long hair, later borrowed for 'cover'.

ety.hint: One person talking 可 over another 可

origin.says: Two 可 (can) stacked, 可 giving the sound; it first meant 'to sing' (the old form of 歌 (song)). Later it was borrowed for 'elder brother', perhaps from a word of northern peoples.
A drawing of a hand with a mark on it, read as a wart (now 疣). The meaning 'especially, outstanding' is a borrowing of its sound.

ety.hint: A great 大 celebration in a house 广

origin.says: Simplified from 慶: an antelope (廌, a festive gift) with 心 (heart): to celebrate. The 1956 form keeps only the top 广 and puts 大 (big) for the rest; no older use is known.

ety.hint: To cover 一 a flame 火

origin.says: Simplified from 滅: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 烕 (fire put out) as the sound: to put out a fire. The simplified form drops 氵 and keeps 火 (fire) under one stroke that covers it.

逼.def: to bother, to pressure; to compel, to force

origin.says: 辶 (walk) for the meaning plus 畐 (full jar) as the sound: to press close upon, to force.

逼.name: press close

闭.def: to shut, to close; to obstruct, to block

ety.hint: A door 门 blocked by bars 才

origin.says: Simplified from 閉: 門 (door) with 才, read as a bar bolting it: to close. The simplified form writes 門 as 门.

闭.name: shut

裁.def: to trim, to reduce, to cut; judgment

ety.hint: To cut 戈 cloth 衣

origin.says: 衣 (clothing) for the meaning plus 𢦏 (a blade) as the sound: to cut cloth to size, then to cut down and to judge.

裁.name: tailor cut

醒.def: to wake up, to startle; to sober up

origin.says: 酉 (wine jar, alcohol) for the meaning plus 星 (star) as the sound: to sober up after drinking, hence to wake up.

醒.name: wake up

托.def: to raise, to support; to entrust, to rely on

ety.hint: Using one's hands 扌 for support 乇; 乇 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 乇 (a sprouting plant) as the sound: to hold up on the palm, to support; then to entrust.

托.name: prop up

origin.says: A picture of a fish, head up, scales in the middle, tail below. Simplified from 魚 by writing the four-dot tail 灬 as one stroke.

鱼.name: fish
鱼.in: 鲜鲁渔鲨鲸鲤鲍鲫鳄鳍癣鳖鳞

探.def: to find, to locate; to grope for, to search for

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 罙 (a hand reaching into a cave, deep) as the sound: to grope for, to explore. First written 罙 alone.

探.name: probe

阻.def: to hinder, to impede; to obstruct, to oppose

origin.says: 阝 (mound, hill) for the meaning plus 且 (altar) as the sound: a hill in the way, to obstruct.

阻.name: block

origin.says: Simplified from 憲 (law), whose old build was 心 (heart) under a sound part. The simplified form is new: 宀 (roof) with 先 (first) as the sound.
A picture of an ox head seen from the front, with its two horns curving up.

牛.name: ox
牛.in: 物解特件牲牺牵牢牧蟹犀牡懈犁

ety.hint: A phrase 勹 from the mouth 口

origin.says: Built from 丩 (two entangled cords) and 口 (mouth); one reading takes 丩 as the sound, another as the meaning "hooked" with 口 as the sound. First meaning "hooked, bent", then a phrase or sentence. The 丩 has since turned into the look-alike 勹 (wrap).

ety.hint: The time for planting seeds 子 of grain 禾

origin.says: 禾 (grain) above 子 (child): young grain, first meaning 'young, youngest brother'; later a season of the year. The exact reasoning is not clear.
亻 (person) for the meaning plus 半 (half) as the sound: a companion, the other half of a pair.
女 (woman) for the meaning plus 未 (not yet) as the sound: a younger female sibling.

鼓.def: drum; to beat, to strike; to rouse

origin.says: 壴 (a drum on a stand) plus 支 (a hand holding a stick): beating a drum; hence drum, to beat, to rouse.
origin.src: Wiktionary; Dong Chinese (one source reads 支 as sound)

鼓.name: drum

休.def: to rest; to stop; to retire

ety.hint: A person 亻 leaning against a tree 木

origin.says: 亻 (person) plus 木 (tree): a man leaning against a tree, resting.

休.name: rest

origin.says: A drawing of curling clouds. It was borrowed for 'to say', so 雨 (rain) was added to write cloud as 雲; simplified Chinese went back to 云 for both.

云.name: cloud
云.in: 会动运层坛尝偿绘魂酝耘

顺.def: to submit to, to obey, to go along with

origin.says: 页 (head) for the meaning plus 川 (river) as the sound; one reading takes both as meaning: the head going with the river's flow, to obey. Simplified from 順 (頁 → 页).

顺.name: go with flow

尊.def: to honor, to respect, to venerate

ety.hint: A hand 寸 making an offering of wine 酋

origin.says: A hand 寸 (hand) holding up 酋 (wine jar): offering a vessel of wine to show respect. An older form had two hands instead of one.

尊.name: honor

origin.says: From 鍵: 金 (metal) for the meaning plus 建 (build) as the sound, a metal bolt or key. The simplified form uses the short metal sign 钅.

ety.hint: Meat on the ribs of an animal

origin.says: A picture of a slab of meat with lines for the fibres or ribs. As a side component it came to be written like 月 (moon).
月 (flesh) for the meaning plus 佥 (all) as the sound: first the cheeks, then the whole face. Simplified from 臉 by shortening 僉 to 佥.
辶 (walking) for the meaning plus 余 (surplus) as the sound: a road, a way, a journey.

ety.hint: Simplified form of 麗; the antlers of a deer 鹿

origin.says: From 麗: a deer 鹿 (deer) with a pair of fine antlers on top: paired, then beautiful. The simplified form keeps only the antlers.

允.def: to grant, to consent; just, fair

origin.says: Oracle bones drew a person with the head stressed, nodding 'yes', so 'to consent'. Later the head was replaced by 㠯 (an old form of 以, by means of) as a sound part, now written 厶 (private) over 儿 (legs). Wiktionary instead sees hands behind the back.
origin.src: CUHK; Dong Chinese (local copy); Wiktionary (local copy)

允.name: consent

归.def: to return, to go back; to return to, to revert

ety.hint: Simplified form of 歸; a wife 帚 returning home; 追 provides the pronunciation

origin.says: Simplified from 歸: 𠂤 (troops) with 帚 (broom) and 止 (foot): troops going home after a campaign, to return. The simplified form keeps two strokes for 𠂤 and 彐, the top of 帚.

归.name: return home

顿.def: to pause; to bow; to arrange

origin.says: 页 (head) for the meaning plus 屯 as the sound: to knock the head to the ground in a bow, hence a pause, a stop, and a measure word for meals. Simplified from 頓.

顿.name: pause

散.def: to scatter, to disperse, to break up

ety.hint: A hand 攵 tossing seeds from a basket

origin.says: Oldest forms show trees or bamboo with 攴 (to strike): knocking stalks apart. 月 (meat) was added later; the stalks became 龷. Hence to scatter, break up. The role of 月 is disputed.

散.name: scatter

origin.says: 辶 (walking, going around) for the meaning plus 扁 (flat) as the sound: going all over, everywhere, and so one time through. A variant of the older 徧, written with 彳 (step).

混.def: muddy, confused; to mix, to blend; to mingle

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 昆 (elder brother) as the sound: water flowing all together, muddy, mixed.

混.name: mix

餐.def: to eat, to dine; meal, food

origin.says: 𣦼 (to tear apart) as the sound plus 食 (food) for the meaning: first to swallow, now a meal.

餐.name: meal

origin.says: 纟 (silk) for the meaning plus 氏 (clan) as the sound: paper, first made of silk fibres. Simplified from 紙 by writing 糸 (silk) as 纟.

描.def: to copy, to depict, to sketch, to trace

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 苗 (sprout) as the sound: what the hand does when it traces or sketches.

描.name: trace

origin.says: 贝 (shell, money) for the meaning plus 卯 (mortise; 4th branch) as the sound, written in a squeezed form on top: exchanging goods, trade. Simplified from 貿 (貝 → 贝).

抱.def: to embrace, to hold in one's arms; to enfold

ety.hint: To wrap 包 in one's arms 扌; 包 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 包 (wrap) as the sound and hint: to wrap in the arms, to hug.

抱.name: hug

origin.says: Simplified from 瘋: 疒 (sickness) for the meaning plus 風 (wind) as the sound, now 风: a sickness of the mind, crazy.
A drawing of a plant growing thickly: lush, abundant. The simplified form also stands for 豐 (a vessel 豆 heaped with plants), whose meaning "plenty" it took over.

丰.name: abundance
丰.in: 害帮绑慧辖割峰锋缝瞎契篷蜂逢艳邦豁蓬梆蚌

订.def: to make an order; to draw up an agreement

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 丁 (nail) as the sound: to settle something in words, to draw up an agreement or place an order. Simplified from 訂, with 言 (speech) written in its short form.

订.name: booking

origin.says: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 公 (public) as the sound: the pine tree. In simplification it also took over 鬆 (loose), so it now means 'loose, relaxed' too.

兼.def: both, and; at the same time; to unite, to combine

ety.hint: A hand holding two sheafs of grain 禾

origin.says: A hand (又) holding two stalks of grain (禾) at once: 'both, double, at the same time'. Compare 秉 (hold), a hand holding one stalk.

兼.name: two sheaves

搜.def: to seek, to search, to investigate

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 叟 (old man) as the sound. 叟 itself first drew a hand holding a torch in a house, 'to search'; the hand was added once 叟 meant 'old man'.

搜.name: rummage

树.def: tree; to plant; to set up, to establish

origin.says: From 樹: 木 (tree) for the meaning plus 尌 (to plant) as sound and meaning; the drum part 壴 of 尌 was replaced by 又 (hand), so the right side now looks like 对.

树.name: tree

origin.says: 禾 (grain plant) over a part that once was 引 (draw out): the grain putting out its ears and flowers. The bottom wore down into 乃. From blooming came 'fine, elegant, outstanding'.

敢.def: bold, brave; to dare, to venture

ety.hint: A hand with a stick 攵 striking a beast 耳

origin.says: Early forms show a hand (又) with a hunting tool facing a wild boar: daring to take on a beast, so bold, to dare. A mouth part was added later and the whole shape changed beyond recognition.

敢.name: dare

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 可 (can) as the sound: a river, first the Yellow River. Early forms also used 何 (what) as the sound.

泛.def: to drift, to float; broad, vast; careless, reckless

origin.says: 氵 (water) for the meaning plus 乏 (lacking) as the sound: to float and drift on water, then to spread widely, broad.

泛.name: drift

ety.hint: Water 氵 collected in a container 匚

origin.says: From 匯: 匚 (box) for the meaning plus 淮 (Huai river) as the sound, waters flowing together. The simplification kept only the 氵 (water) of 淮; it also replaced 彙 (category).

ety.hint: Older brother 儿 speaking 口 to younger ones

origin.says: An open 口 (mouth) on top of 儿 (person): the one who gives orders, the elder brother.

祝.def: to pray; to wish well; surname

ety.hint: A person 兄 praying before an altar 礻

origin.says: A kneeling person with an open mouth (兄 (elder brother) in shape) beside 礻 (altar): someone praying at the altar, hence to pray, to wish well.

祝.name: good wishes

跳.def: to hop, to skip; to jump, to leap; to vault; to dance

origin.says: 𧾷 (foot) for the meaning plus 兆 (omen) as the sound: to jump, leap.

跳.name: jump

origin.says: 采 (pluck) as the sound plus 彡 (streaks, decoration) for the meaning: bright colors.

陈.def: to display, to exhibit; to plead; surname

ety.hint: To place 阝 facing east 东

origin.says: Simplified from 陳: 阝 (mound) for the meaning plus 東 (east) as the sound, written 东 in the simplified form: to lay out, to display. One source says 陳 was first written like 陣 (battle line) and 車 (chariot) was later swapped for 東.

陈.name: display

origin.says: Simplified from 偉: 亻 (person) for the meaning plus 韦 (leather) as the sound: a great, imposing person. 韋 became the cursive 韦.
口 (mouth) for the meaning plus 牙 (tooth) as the sound: a spoken particle of surprise.

ety.hint: Grain 禾 paid as tribute 兑; 兑 also provides the pronunciation

origin.says: 禾 (grain) for the meaning plus 兑 (exchange) as the sound and hint: grain handed over to the state, tax.

拒.def: to defend, to ward off; to refuse

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 巨 (huge) as the sound: to ward off with the hand, to refuse.

拒.name: refuse

荣.def: glory, honor; to flourish, to prosper

ety.hint: Grass 艹 and trees 木 flourishing in a garden 冖

origin.says: Simplified from 榮: 木 (tree) for the meaning with a shortened 熒 (glowing fire) as the sound, a tree in bloom, glory. The two fires on top became 艹 (grass).

荣.name: glory

origin.says: An abridgement of 爾, one reading a drawing of threads on a loom, borrowed for the old word 'you'. The simplified form keeps only the top and a 小 (small)-like bottom.

侵.def: to invade, to encroach upon, to raid

origin.says: 亻 (person) plus a hand 又 holding a broom (shortened 帚): a person sweeping forward step by step, to encroach, invade.

侵.name: invade

操.def: to conduct, to manage, to run

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 喿 (birds chirping in a tree) as the sound: to hold in the hand, then to handle, manage or drill.

操.name: handle

掉.def: to drop, to fall, to remove

origin.says: 扌 (hand) for the meaning plus 卓 (tall) as the sound: originally to shake or swing; now to drop, to fall, to lose.

掉.name: drop

讯.def: news, information; to question, to interrogate

origin.says: 讠 (speech) for the meaning plus 卂 (to fly fast) as the sound: to question, and the news one gets. Simplified from 訊 by the short speech radical.

讯.name: news

ety.hint: A hand holding a large carpenter's square 工

origin.says: A drawing of a carpenter's square, once held by a man (now written 矩). It was borrowed for its sound to mean 'huge'.
